reports.text: Patient presents with chest pain and troponin rise. ECG without ST elevation. Differential includes NSTEMI vs supply-demand ischemia. Urgent clinician escalation recommended.
Troponin I elevated serially. Hemoglobin stable. Creatinine at baseline.

specialistQuestions: Does this presentation warrant escalation to acute cardiac care?

recommendedNextSteps: Discuss escalation to acute care / cardiology urgently
Discuss serial ECGs and inpatient monitoring
